text: Approx. 11 hour delay both times. Messed up first procedure. Avoid!

restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่ศัลยกรรม
text: On October 15, 2014, a young, innocent girl had her first cosmetic surgery. Back then, there wasn't much information available. We chose a clinic close to home in case the doctor could provide support if needed. We had arm liposuction done here for 30,000 baht, which was expensive at the time. I remember it vividly because it was terrible. The procedure was done without an anesthesiologist, without any general anesthesia; they only gave me local anesthesia. It was incredibly painful, but I endured it because I wanted my arms to be more toned. I later found out that other clinics provide much better aftercare, but here...ugh. There were no follow-up appointments for wound cleaning, no follow-up appointments whatsoever. It turned out that the incisions weren't stitched at all. You heard right, not stitched. To this day, I still have indented scars from the liposuction at this clinic. A terrible experience.

restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่ศัลยกรรม
text: I'm so upset. Anyone thinking of going to this clinic, make sure they actually take your booking or just take your name but don't reserve a time slot. I had a silicone removal appointment booked two weeks in advance. The day before, I called to confirm, and it was cancelled. When I arrived, I told the staff I had a booking for 11 am. She asked who I booked with, and I showed her my phone number. She just nodded and didn't say anything, then led me to register. After filling out all the consent forms, they changed my appointment time to 5-6 pm. What kind of service is that? It's a huge change, not just 30 minutes or an hour, it's like waiting all day! What about the booking I made a week in advance? If they don't take bookings, why confirm a time if they can't? They should be upfront about it so customers can plan accordingly. Everyone has responsibilities. In short, my entire schedule was messed up that day. My language teaching schedule was moved to the afternoon from 10 am because of the 11 am silicone removal appointment, and then the clinic changed my appointment to the afternoon too. My schedule clashed completely! We chose not to do it here because they are not punctual. Appointments are not kept. My boyfriend also lost work time because he had to take time off to take care of me and drop me off. He complained to reception about why he had an appointment scheduled for a week ago but now had to queue again. The response he got was terrible. They said, "See? Other people have appointments too. They're waiting too." If you're going to schedule an appointment and it can't be kept, it's better not to confirm it at all. That way I'll know how to manage my time properly.

restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่ศัลยกรรม
text: Terrible. The doctor must have changed his name a hundred times. He didn't care about the surgery at all, talking on the phone the whole time. He rushed through the procedure haphazardly and crookedly just to get it over with. Awful. The result is terrible; I'm left with nothing but scars and no improvement. It was a complete waste of money and I'm disfigured for nothing.

text: I had double eyelid surgery. My eyelids were very large. My eyelids were drooping as usual. My eyes were not shaped at all. The place was stuffy. The doctor did the surgery in a rush because he had to travel to many provinces.
